adjudication.rationale: In `handleNewBooking.ts`, `evt.destinationCalendar` is set to `null` when neither `eventType.destinationCalendar` nor `organizerUser.destinationCalendar` exists (`destinationCalendar: ... : null`). Immediately after, for COLLECTIVE team events, teammates' destination calendars are added via `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)`, which is a silent no-op when `destinationCalendar` is `null`. This drops all teammate calendars in exactly the case described (organizer has none, teammates do), preventing the new multi-destination behavior from being applied.
